plan.change: Close remaining adversarial audit findings in Change OS Phase A+B
expectedChanges: Parse candidate Plan Lock as data without evaluating candidate-controlled path text
Re-run Change PR Gate when pull request base or metadata is edited
Apply unknown-code risk floor to executable-mode files and broaden unregistered executable source classification
Add regression coverage for the three post-review findings without changing town runtime or production
hqDecisions: Keep this change limited to the two P1 findings and one P2 finding from the post-remediation review
Do not begin Phase C trusted evidence, Phase D Git hardening, or Phase E semantic scope/concurrency work
Preserve lightweight handling for known low-risk content while ensuring arbitrary executable-mode files cannot fall through as INFO only
plan.manualCheckExemptionReason: No town/runtime UI or asset behavior changes; verification is mechanical and PR-gate behavior will be exercised by CI/canary.
plan.rollback: Revert the follow-up branch/PR; production remains untouched.
outOfScope: Phase C static evidence provenance and trusted execution
Phase E semantic diff templates and stale-write/concurrency protection
unverified: Repository required-check/ruleset enforcement remains separate from this follow-up.
plan.problem: Three post-remediation findings remain: candidate-controlled lock path text can reach JavaScript evaluation in the privileged gate, base edits do not retrigger the gate, and executable classification can miss arbitrary executable-mode or additional source paths.
plan.currentContract: Change PR Gate runs from the trusted base and Risk Gate derives a floor from changed paths, but these three edge cases still allow bypass or stale approval.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: The latest review reproduced a code-execution path through lock filename interpolation, a stale check after PR base changes, and INFO-only handling for executable paths outside the fixed extension/name allowlist.
plan.design: Keep pull_request_target orchestration base-owned, parse lock JSON only as data through argv/file reads, subscribe the gate to edited events, and augment risk derivation with Git executable-mode detection plus broader source/config classification while leaving Phase C/D/E untouched.
alternativesRejected: Move back to pull_request candidate-owned workflow execution
Treat every unknown documentation or content path as high-risk
Bundle trusted evidence provenance or NUL-path hardening into this follow-up
plan.migration: No runtime data migration. Existing v0.2 Plan Locks and normal low-risk paths remain compatible.
plan.compatibility: Town runtime and production behavior are unchanged; existing Change OS plans continue to validate.
boundaryCases: Plan Lock path containing quote/comma-like candidate text
PR base branch edited after a passing gate
new extensionless file with Git executable bit
new Go source, nested Dockerfile, or .github action definition
ordinary README/docs content remains outside high-risk fallback unless executable
testPlan: Add workflow regression assertions for edited trigger and non-evaluating lock parse
Add risk tests for executable-mode paths and broadened executable source/config paths
Run all Change Operations tests and node syntax checks
Open a staging PR so the trusted base gate evaluates the locked plan and implementation
plan.promotionRisk: No production promotion. Only Change OS staging tooling/workflows are modified.
